source: ChronoSpec Horological Intelligence & WatchCharts Global Aggregate

rolex_sub_126610ln.name: Rolex Submariner Date 41mm Black
rolex_sub_126610ln.case_spec: 41.0mm x 12.3mm, 904L Oystersteel, 300m water resistance, Cerachrom bezel
authenticity_vectors: Laser-Etched Coronet (LEC) at 6 o'clock composed of micro-dots only visible with 10x loupe under angled LED.
Laser rehaut serial typography aligned strictly with dial minute hashes.
Hand stack height: Hour hand bottom, Minute hand middle, Seconds hand top on rounded central pinion.
Cerachrom bezel: Recessed platinum PVD numerals with sharp geometric wall transitions.

chronic_faults.detail: Lubricant migration away from escape wheel pivots reducing balance amplitude below 200 degrees.
Accumulated grit eroding micro-adjustment tooth detents causing slippage under wrist tension.
Ultrasonic bath chemicals leaching platinum PVD coating leaving dull gray numerals.

rolex_sub_126610lv.name: Rolex Submariner Date 41mm 'Starbucks / Kermit'
authenticity_vectors: MK1 vs MK2 Bezel Shade: 2020-2023 MK1 is darker forest green; late 2023+ MK2 is lime/olive hue.
Dial text sharpness: 'SUBMARINER' text must feature razor-sharp pad-printing with no fuzzy edges.

chronic_faults.detail: Dealers swapping damaged green bezels with aftermarket replica inserts or MK2 colors.
Timing machine indicates 180-210 amplitude in dial-up position after 2 years.

rolex_sub_116610lv.name: Rolex Submariner Date 40mm 'Hulk' Green Dial & Bezel
rolex_sub_116610lv.case_spec: 40.0mm x 12.5mm 'Maxi Case', Sunburst green dial, Cerachrom bezel
authenticity_vectors: Sunburst Green Gold Dial: Genuine dials contain real gold powder in lacquer; fakes lack radial sunray reflection under sunlight.
Maxi Case Lug Profiles: Squared, wide lug silhouette with crisp, sharp factory brushed bevels.

chronic_faults.detail: Base black 116610LN fitted with aftermarket green dial/bezel sold at $10k premium.
Unlubricated 3135 rotor axle causing heavy rotor to scrape movement bridge.

rolex_sub_16610.name: Rolex Submariner Date 40mm Aluminum Bezel
rolex_sub_16610.case_spec: 40.0mm x 12.8mm, Lug holes (pre-2003) or no-holes case (2003+), Aluminum bezel insert
authenticity_vectors: Swiss-T<25 (Tritium until ~1998), 'SWISS' only (1998-1999 Luminova), 'SWISS MADE' (2000+ Super-LumiNova).
Case Lug Thickness: 90% of pre-owned 16610s have been over-polished by jewellers, thinning lug horns.

chronic_faults.detail: Pins between folded hollow steel links wearing into oval shapes, causing severe 45-degree droop.
Cheap replacement bezel insert lacking correct flat-top four font.

rolex_daytona_126500ln.name: Rolex Cosmograph Daytona 40mm Ceramic (New Gen)
rolex_daytona_126500ln.case_spec: 40.0mm x 11.9mm, Metal outer ring surrounding Cerachrom bezel, 904L steel
authenticity_vectors: Outer Metallic Bezel Ring: Refined design framing the ceramic insert with polished steel lip.
Subdial ring slimming: Subdials are narrower and sharper than outgoing 116500LN.

chronic_faults.detail: Cross-threading pusher locking collars when operated under hurry.

rolex_daytona_116500ln.name: Rolex Cosmograph Daytona 'Panda' White Dial
rolex_daytona_116500ln.case_spec: 40.0mm x 12.2mm, Monobloc Cerachrom ceramic bezel, 904L Oystersteel
authenticity_vectors: Thickness verification: Exactly 12.2mm thickness. High-grade replicas exceed 12.5mm.
Subdial concentric snailing: Precision guilloché rings inside the 3 subdials under magnification.

chronic_faults.detail: Vertical clutch friction spring fatigue causing minute subdial hand to skip ticks.
Micro-impact at 12 o'clock fracturing ceramic crystal perimeter.

rolex_daytona_116520.name: Rolex Cosmograph Daytona Stainless Steel Bezel
rolex_daytona_116520.case_spec: 40.0mm x 12.2mm, Engraved steel tachymetre bezel, White/Black dial (APH dial variation)
authenticity_vectors: APH Dial Flaw Premium: 'COSMOGR   APH' gap in dial font commands 10-15% collector premium.
Polished Steel Bezel: Radial brushed grain on steel bezel quickly destroyed by amateur buffing.

chronic_faults.detail: Black enamel filling in engraved numbers fading or washing out from solvent contact.

rolex_gmt_126710blro.name: Rolex GMT-Master II 'Pepsi' Jubilee/Oyster
rolex_gmt_126710blro.calibre: Rolex Calibre 3285 (70h reserve, Jumping Local Hour)
rolex_gmt_126710blro.case_spec: 40.0mm x 12.1mm, Red/Blue Bi-Color Cerachrom, Jubilee or Oyster bracelet
authenticity_vectors: Ceramic Color Demarcation: Seamless split at 6 and 18 without bleeding or jagged pigment overlap.
Hand Stack: Hour bottom, GMT Hand (Red) middle-lower, Minute hand middle-upper, Seconds top.

chronic_faults.issue: MK1 Pastel vs MK2/MK3 Dark Bezel Disputes
chronic_faults.detail: Dealers misrepresenting MK3 darker bezels as rare early 2018 pastel MK1 bezels.
Internal cam spring binding if adjusted during date change turnover.

rolex_gmt_126710blnr.name: Rolex GMT-Master II 'Batman / Batgirl'
authenticity_vectors: Blue GMT Hand Color Match: Powder blue paint on GMT hand must exactly match Cerachrom bezel blue tone.

chronic_faults.detail: Watch halts after 35-40 hours instead of rated 70 hours due to barrel arbor friction.

rolex_gmt_126720vtnr.name: Rolex GMT-Master II 'Sprite' Left-Handed Destro
rolex_gmt_126720vtnr.calibre: Rolex Calibre 3285 (Crown at 9 o'clock, Date at 9 o'clock)
rolex_gmt_126720vtnr.case_spec: 40.0mm x 12.1mm, Green/Black Cerachrom bezel, Destro configuration
authenticity_vectors: Date Wheel Inversion: Date disc numbers must be oriented correctly for left-side cyclops reading.

chronic_faults.detail: Left wrist impacts catching the exposed 9 o'clock crown.

rolex_datejust_126334.name: Rolex Datejust 41 Fluted Bezel Jubilee (Wimbledon / Blue)
rolex_datejust_126334.case_spec: 41.0mm x 11.7mm, 18k White Gold fluted bezel, 904L Oystersteel, Jubilee bracelet
authenticity_vectors: 18k White Gold Fluted Bezel: Flutes have razor-sharp pyramidal facets with intense mirror reflection.
Wimbledon Dial '9' Marker: Only the 9 o'clock baton is lumed; Roman numerals are slate-grey with green lacquer outlines.

chronic_faults.detail: Soft 18k gold facets easily flattened by door frame bumps, requiring complete bezel replacement.
Requires complete teardown and re-lubrication under factory spec.

rolex_daydate_228238.name: Rolex Day-Date 40 'President' 18k Yellow Gold
rolex_daydate_228238.calibre: Rolex Calibre 3255 (Day-Date instantaneously changing at midnight)
rolex_daydate_228238.case_spec: 40.0mm x 12.0mm, Solid 18k Yellow Gold, President bracelet with ceramic pin sleeves
authenticity_vectors: Weight verification: Genuine 228238 weighs approximately 205-215 grams in solid gold. Gold-plated replicas weigh 145-160 grams.
Hallmarks: Saint Bernard dog head (0.750 18k Swiss hallmark) and scales stamped under lugs.
Ceramic link inserts: Inside the President bracelet links preventing gold-on-gold friction wear.

chronic_faults.issue: Solid Gold Link Stretch & Pin Sag
chronic_faults.detail: Older non-ceramic sleeve models developing severe bracelet droop over 5+ years.
Day window clicking 5-15 minutes past midnight due to worn jumper wheel teeth.

rolex_explorer_124270.name: Rolex Explorer I 36mm Classic Dial
rolex_explorer_124270.case_spec: 36.0mm x 11.5mm, 19mm lug width taper, Gloss black dial, Chromalight 3-6-9 numerals
authenticity_vectors: Chromalight 3-6-9 Lume: Solid white gold numerals filled with blue Chromalight phosphorescent compound.

chronic_faults.detail: Aggressive 19mm taper makes strap swapping prone to gouging inner lug flanks.

rolex_explorer2_226570.name: Rolex Explorer II 42mm 'Polar' White Dial
rolex_explorer2_226570.case_spec: 42.0mm x 12.5mm, Satin-brushed steel 24-hour fixed bezel, Polar white lacquer dial
authenticity_vectors: Phantom Hands on Black Dial vs Gloss Black Surrounds on Polar: Lume plots surrounded in deep gloss PVD black borders.

chronic_faults.detail: Fixed steel 24-hr bezel cannot be spot-polished without erasing circular brushed pattern.

rolex_seadweller_126600.name: Rolex Sea-Dweller 43mm 'Single Red'
rolex_seadweller_126600.calibre: Rolex Calibre 3235 (Helium Escape Valve, Cyclops lens)
rolex_seadweller_126600.case_spec: 43.0mm x 15.2mm, Helium escape valve, 1220m / 4000ft, Red 'SEA-DWELLER' text
authenticity_vectors: Red Line Typography: Pure red single-line pad printing paying homage to vintage 1665 Great White.
Helium Escape Valve: Flush titanium valve on 9 o'clock flank.

chronic_faults.detail: Failure of gas decompression gasket under pressure testing.

rolex_skydweller_326934.name: Rolex Sky-Dweller Annual Calendar Blue Dial
rolex_skydweller_326934.calibre: Rolex Calibre 9001/9002 (Saros Annual Calendar, Ring Command Bezel)
rolex_skydweller_326934.case_spec: 42.0mm x 14.0mm, 18k White Gold Ring Command bezel, 904L steel
authenticity_vectors: Month Indicator Red Aperture: Red rectangular window above the 12 hour indices denoting current month (Saros mechanism).
Ring Command Bezel: Bezel rotates through 3 distinct position detents to select calendar adjustment mode.

chronic_faults.detail: Damage to planetary gear interface between bezel and movement if forced while crown is pulled.

rolex_op41_124300.name: Rolex Oyster Perpetual 41 'Celebration / Tiffany / Green'
rolex_op41_124300.case_spec: 41.0mm x 11.5mm, Domed bezel, Oyster bracelet, Lacquered Stella-tribute dials
authenticity_vectors: Dial Paint Authenticity: Celebration dial features 5 distinct circular bubble colors with black outlines under 20x magnification.
Repaint Fraud: Repainted black/silver base dials disguised as rare Tiffany Turquoise dials.

chronic_faults.detail: Base $6k silver OP41 fitted with $100 fake turquoise dial sold for $18,000.

rolex_milgauss_116400gv.name: Rolex Milgauss Z-Blue Green Sapphire Glass
rolex_milgauss_116400gv.calibre: Rolex Calibre 3131 (Ferromagnetic Soft Iron Shield 1,000 Gauss)
rolex_milgauss_116400gv.case_spec: 40.0mm x 13.1mm, Glace Verte (Green-tinted sapphire crystal), Orange lightning bolt seconds hand
authenticity_vectors: Green Sapphire Bevel: Rolex never patented the green sapphire crystal because it was too difficult to replicate. Replicas use green AR coating or tinted gasket.
Lightning Bolt Seconds Hand: Sinuous orange lacquer hand with precise razor-sharp edges.

chronic_faults.detail: Any chip on the green sapphire crystal requires an expensive official service-only replacement.
